{{Quote|My focus must be finding and destroying the holocron of Nul left here. All of her designs--her plans--could be within. I will not stop until I erase every last dark stain left by the Children of the Emperor...|[[Denolm Orr]]|<ref name="TOR:DD">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Nul's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] of [[Darth Nul]], the creator of the [[Children of the Emperor]], that was said to contain all of her secrets. 

==History==
[[File:Darth_Nuls_holocron_in_Holocron_Machine.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Nul's holocron was used to power the [[Holocron Machine]].]]
Centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named Raniah possessed a unique ability that enabled her to connect her mind to another's through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and developed the belief that any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] deserved to be trained in their powers. However, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] felt her beliefs were dangerous and exiled her. Undeterred, Raniah took her followers to a distant planet in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], where she taught them to forge mental bonds as she did and invited others to their sanctuary. But one day, Raniah made contact with someone she did not expect: the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. She and her followers to then captured by the Sith and turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Old Wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

Under her new Sith identity, Darth Nul, she worked create a machine that could replicate her ability to touch the minds of others. The most critical component of the machine was a holocron, imbued with her own essence. It was her intention to awaken the Force in others, whether they had forgotten or were unaware of their connection, on a galactic scale. However, one of her acolytes, acting under either deceit or torture, revealed her plans to the Emperor. Desperate to conceal her inventions from the Emperor's attention, hoping to create a new device to distract him so she could return to Elom and finish her work.<ref name="Library">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>

The holocron was being kept in the [[Temple of Nul]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] until it was visited by [[Darth Malgus]] around [[3625 BBY]]. At the end of the [[Mission to Elom|events that transpired]], [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] escaped with the holocron.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Ruins of Nul|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>

When used in conjunction with a Sith machine, the holocron had the ability to amplify the abilities of only weakly [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals, though it did not affect their underlying personality.<ref name="Defiance">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Desperate Defiance|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>

[[File:Sahar_Kateen_with_holocron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Sa'har Kateen]] with the holocron]]
After defeating [[Ri'kan Kateen]] on the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Hidden Chain flagship|command ship]] and destroying the Sith machine, the [[Alliance Commander]] managed to finally acquire the holocron and escaped the ship as it was about to explode.<ref name="sundering" />

The Commander later brought the holocron back to Elom after the successful excavation of the underground sanctum of Nul's temple and [[Talos Drellik]]'s successful repair of Nul's assistant droid. Upon approaching the door Nul's lab, the holocron emitted what Drellik assumed to be a "resonant frequency" that caused the door to open. After undergoing Nul's trials and acquiring three scrolls that unlocked holorecordings of Nul, the droid suddenly plugged itself onto the central column. Drellik then suggested that the slot on the droid was meant to hold the holocron, which the Commander inserted, at which it began playing Nul's last message. However, the party soon realized that the modern uplink device fitted to the replacement part used to repair the droid had spontaneously activated. With Drellik unable to stop the transmission and the holocron remaining fused to the droid, against Drellik's protests, his companions destroyed the droid, though fortunately the holocron remained intact. This triggered a trap, activating several guard droids that began attacking the Commander and their companions. After narrowly surviving the attack, the Commander retrieved the holocron.<ref name="Library">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|[[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]}}</ref>

The Commander, accompanied by [[Lana Beniko]], continued to hold onto the holocron during [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|mission]] to the ruins of [[Emperor's Fortress|Malgus' fortress]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in search of the missing survey team. As the pair ventured into the ruins, they discovered records from Dr. [[Farrus Belisk]] and his team, who were being killed off by a mysterious presence, shortly before that same presence reanimated their corpses as cyberneurotic zombies. The Commander and Beniko fought their way to the Emperor's vault, where they discovered a [[Rakatan]] [[Darth Nul's mind prison|mind prison]]. With the holocron reacting to the device, the pair decide to venture inside and discovered that spirit of Darth Nul, who was imprisoned by the Sith Emperor after he discovered that she intended to awaken the Force in many on a galactic scale, threatening his own plans. Nul revealed that Malgus visited her recently, having become sympathetic to her beliefs and she gave him the knowledge to make it a reality. The Commander and Beniko then fought against Darth Nul to keep her from possessing a body and escaping, before they escaped back into the real world themselves, shortly before Nul's mind prison exploded.<ref name="Dark Heart">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Ilum]]}}</ref>

[[File:Sal-Deron_and_holocron.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Master [[Sal-Deron]] with the holocron]]
Upon returning to Odessen, the Commander and Beniko discover a message from [[Darth Jadus]], who revealed that Nul's holocron was the key to the success or failure of Malgus' plan to fundamentally upend the Jedi and Sith.<ref name="Dark Heart" /> Jadus would later send the Alliance a set of coordinates. However, before the Commander could investigate, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Galena Rans]] arrived on [[Odessen]] with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Barus Rava]] and Master [[Sal-Deron]] to confiscate the holocron to keep it from Malgus' hands. However, when Sal-Deron attempted to open the holocron, it violently sent her flying against a wall, leading her to accuse the Commander of tampering with it; Rava, eager to curb the Alliance's independence, supported her accusation, suggesting that the Commander was trying to conceal its secrets. Rans then had the Commander confined to Odessen until Malgus was recaptured or they had cleared them of any tampering with the holocron.<ref name="Enigma">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|[[Enigma (research vessel)|Enigma]]}}</ref>

Disagreeing with the Chancellor's order, [[Tau Idair]] stole the holocron back as she and the Commander escaped Odessen and traveled to Jadus' coordinates, arriving on Nul's derelict research vessel, the ''[[Enigma (research vessel)|Enigma]]''. Upon meeting with Jadus, he explained that Heta Kol had rebuilt Nul's machine, but Malgus was planning to seize it, having planned to realize Nul's vision to spread chaos and burn his name in the stars, but Jadus sought to hijack his plan to manipulate the fear he would unleash and establish his own dominion. However, he revealed that the holocron, now bound to the Commander, could not command Nul's creations to their full effect without its own full functionality unlocked on the ''Enigma''. To that end, he sent the Commander and Idair into the lower levels of the ship, where they explored two biomes being managed by two [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|protocols]], Raniah and Nul, which were based on Darth Nul's own experiences as Jedi and Sith, and both of them reacted to the holocron, but refused to be "assimilated" until their objectives were accomplished. Seeing that the two protocols' experiments were doing more harm than good, the Commander restored both of them to their original states, giving the protocols no choice but to go to the ship's mainframe.<ref name="Enigma" />

Upon arriving at the mainframe, the pair found both versions of Darth Nul commanding holodroids to fight one another for control of the ship. Spotting a slot at the center console, the two raced through the fighting and placed the holocron on it, after which all the droids started attacking them. After holding off their attackers, the holocron started unlocking as both Raniah and Nul merged together to form Darth Nul's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|personality matrix]]. Under questioning from the Commander and Idair, Nul explained that with her personality matrix completed, it was possible to use her machine to its full power, but to reach billions of inhabitants as possible, her machine was strategically placed on Elom. Upon being told of the original machine's destruction, she concluded that the next suitable planet would be [[Khar Shian]].<ref name="Enigma" />

Suddenly, Jadus turned up with his followers, remarking that the Hidden Chain were close to completing Nul's machine on Khar Shian, and declared that the Commander having reached the end of their usefulness. Before the Commander could fight, suddenly Idair immobilized them with a forcefield, revealing that Jadus had told her that Sa'har was his captive and was trying to trade the holocron for her life. But as soon as she passed Jadus the relic, he reminded that he promised both Jedi would be "reunited", shortly before shocking her unconscious with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and taking her captive. Jadus would then proceed to taunt the Commander before taking his leave. But as the Commander managed to free themself, Jadus used both Force illusions and his own troopers to slow the Commander down for him to depart the ''Enigma'' with both his captive and the holocron.<ref name="Enigma" />

==Behind the scenes==
After acquiring the holocron, Imperial players are then contacted by [[Darth Krovos]] while Republic players are contacted by [[Arn Peralun]], both of whom ask to give the holocron to the Empire and Republic respectively. The player can either choose to do so or keep it with them instead.<ref name="sundering" /> This choice is later commented on in '''Game Update 7.5.1: Master's Enigma'''.<ref name="Enigma" />

In the same mission, when the respective faction leader requests the player hand over the holocron, the player can either order Lana Beniko to lower the forcefield around it or refuse, resulting in Sal-Deron or Darth Krovos forcibly seizing it.<ref name="Enigma" />
